body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Pandigital presented its photo, slide & negative scanner 'Panscan05' during Digital Experience at CES 2010.

It features easily scan any photo up to 4"x6" directly to the memory card, scan film negatives and 35mm mounted slides with included tray adapter, images are scanned as 600dpi full color JPEGs, 5-in-1 card reader and SD card included.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
